title: Really Nice But
text: Really Nice But. The cup is really pretty and made nicely. I did like the addition of the two straws, extra lid, and cleaner. Why I knocked off two stars is because the print on the cup was way smaller than pictured. It just didn't look nice and you can barely read it. Overall the cup would be a great value if the print was as large in person as shown on the mockup. Shipping was top notch and the cup was protected.
